scheme_name: Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang (CMAT) – Scheme Of Festival Assistance For Participating In International & National Festival
description:
The Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang (CMAT) is a welfare scheme launched by the Government of Manipur. 

The scheme was officially launched on 25th November 2021. 

It was initiated to provide financial assistance to artists and cultural performers from Manipur. 

The primary objective of CMAT is to encourage and support local artists participating in international and national festivals. 

The scheme aims to promote the rich cultural heritage of Manipur on larger platforms. 

The government has set a target to assist at least 1,000 artists annually under this scheme. 

The financial assistance provided under CMAT is intended to cover various expenses related to participation in festivals. 

These expenses include travel costs, accommodation, and other logistical needs. 

Eligible artists can receive up to ₹50,000 for participating in national festivals. 

For international festivals, the assistance can go up to ₹1,00,000. 

The scheme is designed to ensure that artists do not face financial constraints while showcasing their talents. 

Eligibility for the CMAT scheme is primarily focused on local artists from Manipur. 

Artists must be residents of Manipur and actively engaged in cultural performances. 

There are no specific age limits set for applicants under this scheme. 

However, artists must demonstrate a history of participation in cultural activities. 

They must also provide proof of selection to participate in an international or national festival. 

The application process for CMAT is straightforward and user-friendly. 

Interested artists must fill out an application form available on the official government website. 

The application form requires personal details, including name, address, and contact information. 

Applicants must also provide details about the festival they intend to participate in. 

Supporting documents must be submitted along with the application. 

These documents include an invitation letter from the festival organizers. 

Artists must also submit proof of their artistic credentials. 

This can include certificates, photographs of past performances, or media coverage. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the designated authorities. 

The review process typically takes about 15 to 30 days. 

Successful applicants will receive a confirmation of their financial assistance. 

The disbursement of funds is made directly to the bank accounts of the artists. 

The funds are usually released in two installments. 

The first installment is provided upon approval of the application. 

The second installment is released after the artist submits a report of their participation. 

The CMAT scheme is implemented by the Department of Art and Culture, Government of Manipur. 

This department is responsible for promoting and preserving the cultural heritage of the state. 

The contact details for the Department of Art and Culture can be found on the official government website. 

The scheme has received positive feedback from the artist community in Manipur. 

Many artists have expressed gratitude for the financial support provided. 

The government aims to enhance the visibility of Manipuri culture through this initiative. 

CMAT also serves as a platform for artists to gain recognition at national and international levels. 

The scheme aligns with the broader objectives of the Government of India to promote arts and culture. 

It contributes to the economic empowerment of artists in the region. 

As of October 2023, the scheme has successfully assisted over 500 artists since its launch. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹5 crore for the CMAT scheme for the financial year 2023-2024. 

This budget is expected to support more artists and expand the reach of the scheme. 

The CMAT scheme is part of a larger initiative to promote cultural tourism in Manipur. 

Cultural tourism is seen as a potential driver for economic growth in the state. 

The government encourages artists to participate in various forms of art, including dance, music, and theater. 

The scheme also aims to foster collaboration among artists from different disciplines. 

By providing financial assistance, the government hopes to inspire creativity and innovation among artists. 

The CMAT scheme is a significant step towards preserving the unique cultural identity of Manipur. 

It reflects the government's commitment to supporting the arts and promoting cultural diversity. 

Artists who have benefited from the scheme have reported increased opportunities for performance. 

They have also noted a rise in audience engagement and appreciation for Manipuri culture. 

The CMAT scheme is a vital resource for artists seeking to elevate their careers. 

It provides them with the necessary support to participate in prestigious events. 

The government continues to monitor and evaluate the impact of the CMAT scheme. 

Feedback from artists is actively sought to improve the program further. 

The CMAT scheme exemplifies the government's dedication to cultural promotion and artist welfare. 

It is an essential tool for empowering the artistic community in Manipur. 

The scheme not only supports individual artists but also enriches the cultural landscape of the state. 

Overall, the Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang scheme represents a significant investment in the future of Manipuri arts and culture.
